name: MFTECmd
description: Eric Zimmerman's $MFT parser, outputting SI and FN timestamp sets side by side plus the SI<FN, Copied, and uSecZeros flags used throughout Level 2.

name: KAPE
description: Kroll's targeted collection and processing tool, used to gather and parse endpoint artifacts at scale during triage.

name: Volatility 3
description: The standard open-source memory-forensics framework used throughout Level 5's process, injection, and LSASS analysis lessons.

name: Timeline Explorer
description: Eric Zimmerman's fast CSV/timeline viewer, used for filtering and sorting parsed artifact output across nearly every Level 2 and 3 lesson.

name: Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK
description: The current, supported PowerShell module for Entra ID administration and investigation — including Revoke-MgUserSignInSession, central to Level 6's hybrid runbook.

name: CyberChef
description: A browser-based data-manipulation toolkit used throughout Level 3 for decoding obfuscated PowerShell and extracting MIME attachments.

name: Sysinternals Suite
description: Microsoft's own process, autoruns, and system-internals utilities — baseline tooling referenced across the Windows Endpoint and Persistence levels.

name: Registry Explorer
description: Eric Zimmerman's offline registry-hive viewer, used across the Registry Hives, ShellBags, and UserAssist lessons in Level 2.
